source: M5_shrinkage_v1 synthetic scenarios, first 300 calibration and last 300 development test per injected quality
quality_gate_rule: known injected Q/SOC/R noise oracle and ultra -> explicit; high -> 0.5 uniform + 0.5 explicit; moderate/low/M4_unidentified -> uniform
interval: calibration first 300 scenarios per quality, empirical absolute residual rank ceil((n+1)*0.9), evaluate remaining 300; synthetic only
channel_stress: remove explicit channel -> uniform fallback; add +3Ah bias to explicit predictor as reference-drift proxy with original gates held fixed
claim_limit: Injection noise class is known by construction and not a validated observable on official cells; scenario distribution was adapted during M5 research and is not an independent empirical test
